SRC-001:R1.text: Ship exactly three features: five-minute trials for unowned premium sounds, five-minute trials for unowned premium themes, and one compact home-screen START/STOP widget.

SRC-001:R2.text: No subscription or licensing framework and no widget platform; all accepted core, service, billing, lifecycle and background behaviour preserved.

SRC-001:R4.text: Repeated selection of an already active trial never extends its expiration.

SRC-001:R5.text: After expiry an unowned sound becomes unavailable and an unowned theme stops rendering, with Classic effective again.

SRC-001:R6.text: Trials are reusable rather than one-time: after expiry the same content may start another five-minute trial.

SRC-001:R7.text: No cooldowns, counters, accounts, device IDs, server validation or anti-abuse logic.
